## Activity

During November 2021, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 64 captures. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading performance for the month. The recorded volume is reported as completed site activity and is considered alongside the subsequent assessment outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 3 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.7 per cent. These results are reported together to show the proportion of activity that could not proceed to grading. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

A total of 11 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 8. This measure is presented with the referable result count to support review of the site’s grading activity and turnaround. Overall, the report records the activity completed at Oakridge Primary Care in November 2021, the quality of the submitted images, and the grading outcomes for the reporting period.
